VINAY GANESH

Market Data, Reference Data & Corporate Actions | Capital Markets | Investment Banking Bangalore, India | +91 99454 45117 | vinaygtr@gmail.com | Linkedin

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Dynamic and results-driven Investment Banking professional with 20+ years of specialized expertise across Security Pricing (evaluated pricing & non-pricing data), Corporate Actions lifecycle management, Exchange Reference Data, and Capital Markets operations. Good knowledge of global market data ecosystems spanning equities, fixed income, derivatives. Proven track record leading cross-functional teams of 50+ across data vendors (ICE, Thomson Reuters / Refinitiv) and global BPO/KPO environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Security Pricing & Evaluated Pricing | Non-Pricing Reference Data | Corporate Actions (Mandatory & Voluntary) | Exchange Reference Data | Instrument Master & Security Master | ISIN / CUSIP / SEDOL / FIGI | Bloomberg / ICE / Refinitiv / FactSet | MiFID II / SEC Compliance | Data Governance & Quality Frameworks | Portfolio & Fund Accounting (NAV / P&L) | Stakeholder & Vendor Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Manager - Market Data & Reference Data Operations · HCL Technologies Ltd · Aug 2022 – Present · Bengaluru

▪ Security Pricing (Evaluated Pricing): Lead evaluated-pricing quality assurance for Market instruments, enforcing daily price- challenge SLAs and escalation protocols against Bloomberg, ICE Continuous Pricing, and Markit consensus benchmarks.

▪ Corporate Actions: Direct the full CA lifecycle for mandatory events (dividends, stock splits, mergers, spin-offs,

redemptions) and voluntary events (tender offers, rights issues), reducing operational breaks by 52% through workflow re- engineering.

▪ Exchange Reference Data: Govern coverage across 80+ exchanges globally; maintain MIC codes, CFI codes, trading-status

flags, holiday schedules, tick-size regimes, and lot-size parameters feeding execution management systems

▪ Lead proposal development (RFI/RFP) for global F&A and market data outsourcing mandates; design cost-effective,

technology-enabled solutions including RPA deployment and proprietary tooling, reducing manual touchpoints by 38%. ▪ Drive fund accounting operations — NAV computation, P&L attribution, and position reconciliation — coordinating with

custodians, prime brokers, and counterparties to ensure T+1 settlement accuracy.

Senior Team Leader – Global Reference Data & Pricing Operations · ICE Data Services (InterContinental Exchange) · Nov 2020 – Aug 2022 · Hyderabad

▪ Managed sourcing, validation, and distribution of Security Pricing data for 1.8M+ instruments across equities, derivatives,

ETFs, and indices for institutional buy-side and sell-side clients globally.

▪ Pricing Data: Led Global Reference Data Management for static (instrument master, identifiers, classifications) and real- time attributes (trading status, price factors, accrual bases), ensuring <0.1% error rate across 2M+ security records. ▪ Corporate Actions: Oversaw CA processing across North America, EMEA, and APAC markets, integrating, Euroclear, and

achieved 79% STP rate for mandatory events within 18 months.

▪ Conducted UAT cycles for platform upgrades to ICE's reference data and pricing engines; authored SOP documentation,

operational risk registers, and control frameworks adopted across three global delivery centers.

▪ Coordinated with internal Product, IT, and Vendor Management teams to resolve data feed outages, ensuring 99.93% feed

availability for premium-tier clients.

Deputy Manager – Reference Data & Corporate Actions · WNS Global Services Pvt. Ltd · Sep 2014 – Nov 2020 · Bengaluru

▪ Managed reference data validation for Equities, Indices and Derivatives across NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, Euronext, BSE, and NSE (APAC, EMEA and AMER) covering instrument identifiers, trading attributes, issuer data, and classification hierarchies.

▪ Security Pricing: Authenticated and enriched end-of-day pricing data from Bloomberg, Refinitiv Datascope, and IDC;

implemented daily price-tolerance checks and automated variance-alert workflows, reducing pricing restatements by 34%.

▪ Corporate Actions: Processed and authenticated mandatory and voluntary corporate action events for global equity;

maintained entitlement accuracy above 99.7% across 15,000+ CA events per annum.

▪ Exchange Reference Data: Maintained exchange listing data, trading phase schedules, MIC codes, and market segment

attributes for 60+ global exchanges, feeding OMS and execution platforms.

▪ Led end-to-end project execution including resource planning, training, KPI/MIS reporting, and continuous improvement

initiatives; managed team of 22 analysts across data operations verticals.

▪ Acted as primary client liaison via ServiceNow, JIRA, and Confluence; resolved escalations and delivered quarterly data

quality reviews to global banking and asset management clients.

Senior Content Specialist – Market & Reference Data · Thomson Reuters (now Refinitiv / LSEG) · Jun 2004 – Jun 2014 · Bengaluru

▪ Supported equity, derivatives, ETF, mutual fund, and fixed income data operations on Refinitiv Eikon, Datastream, and

Datascope platforms, building domain expertise across 10 years on a world-leading market data infrastructure.

▪ Security Pricing: Processed daily closing price data, bid/ask spreads, for equity instruments; validated against exchange

feeds and applied corporate action price adjustments.

▪ Non-Pricing Data: Enriched instrument master records with ISIN/SEDOL/RIC mappings, issuer attributes, sector classifications, and fiscal data; maintained mutual fund, ETF, and hedge fund datasets for buy-side clients. Insider Trading: Processed SEC filings (Forms 13-F, 8-K), insider trading disclosures, dividend announcements, and fund financial data; performed root cause analysis on data discrepancies and resolved client escalations at SME level.

▪

▪ Conducted training and mentoring for junior analysts; authored process documentation, quality checklists, and competency

frameworks adopted across the Bengaluru delivery centre.

▪ Performed MIS reporting, SLA tracking, & operational dashboards for onshore stakeholders across the US, UK, and APAC

regions.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

Master of Commerce (Finance) — University of Mysore, 2006 Bachelor of Commerce — Bangalore University, 2003 Six Sigma Green Belt — Certified Quality & Process Improvement Practitioner

TECHNICAL SKILLS & PLATFORMS

Market Data Platforms: Bloomberg, Refinitiv Eikon, Datastream, Datascope, ICE Data Services, FactSet, eSignal, Interactive Data Corporate Actions & Regulatory Compliance: MiFID II (RTS 27/28), SEC EDGAR 10-K/8-K Tools & Technology: SQL (basic), Agile / JIRA / Confluence, ServiceNow

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

▪ 52% reduction in Corporate Actions operational breaks at HCL through workflow re-engineering and real-time entitlement

engine enhancements.

▪ 79% STP rate for mandatory corporate action events achieved at ICE Data Services within 18 months, up from 45% baseline. ▪ 34% reduction in security pricing restatements at WNS through implementation of automated daily price-tolerance check

and variance-alert workflows.

▪ 99.93% feed availability maintained for premium-tier clients at ICE across 1.8M+ instrument pricing and reference data

records.

▪ 10-year SME tenure at Thomson Reuters (Refinitiv) building deep domain expertise across pricing, non-pricing, corporate

actions, and fund data operations — recognized as Subject Matter Expert and senior trainer.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Nationality: Indian | Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu | Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
